metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Ardpoint Networks (mobile operator); Platform: AWS ap-northeast-1 (zones ap-northeast-1a/ap-northeast-1c/ap-northeast-1d); network range 10.99.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster ardpoi-prod-apnort (EKS); Database: mysql server usage-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-40a539fcc19d9507f; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
investigation_questions: Which user or automation account carried out the triggering change?
Which network control object was modified?
What is the IP address of the database host that became unreachable?
Which port was blocked by the change?
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which change restored normal service? Provide its change identifier.
